note: NPS Mojave National Preserve campground beside the Hole-in-the-Wall Information Center, at 4,400 ft among sculpted volcanic rock walls; gravel and packed-dirt sites. The road is paved to the campground turn-off. No cell service (free Wi-Fi at the information center), and no gas or food anywhere in the preserve. --Claude
